Why Harvey

At Harvey, weâre transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, weâre reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. Weâre scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth â personal, professional, and financial â is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission â operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today â and weâre just getting started.


Role Overview

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Harvey, you will drive the growth and success of our AI solutions within the legal and professional services markets. You will be responsible for establishing and growing relationships with law firms and other large enterprise clients, understanding their unique challenges, and presenting AI solutions that streamline their processes and boost productivity. Your ability to articulate the value of Harvey's products, coupled with your passion for groundbreaking AI technologies, will help us shape the future of knowledge work.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and manage a named account list and be responsible for the full sales cycle from prospecting to contracting to onboarding, launching, and growing new users.

  • Achieve and exceed revenue targets and other key sales metrics.

  • Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Harveyâs solutions to meet customer needs. Collaborate closely with the engineering and product teams to stay updated on the latest AI advancements and tailor solutions to meet client goals.

  • Build strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, understanding their pain points and aligning Harvey's solutions with their needs.

  • Conduct product demonstrations and presentations, showcasing the power of Harvey's AI systems to prospects and clients.

  • Develop our sales playbook to enable scaling, documenting learnings that can be applied across accounts.

What You Have

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise B2B SaaS sales, with a proven track record of selling complex software solutions to enterprise clients and the ability to successfully execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology.

  • Proven experience selling into the Quebec/local market, with fluency in French.

  • Proven track record of selling complex software solutions to enterprise clients, with the ability to successfully execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology.

  • Ability to lead a complex, multi-threaded sale with stakeholders ranging from executives across various functions to day-to-day product users â especially the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Demonstrated passion for Harveyâs mission and strong understanding of AI and its potential applications in knowledge work and interest in the legal profession and helping lawyers do their jobs better and more efficiently.

  • Excited about prospecting, and capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish.

  • Team player who can collaborate effectively across internal functions (product, legal, etc.) to achieve common goals.

  • Energized by contributing to the development of our sales processes and team-driven sales culture, refining the value proposition of our solutions and creating sales resources to drive our success.

Location

  • Must be located in Quebec but will work remotely with occasional visit to our Toronto Office.

Compensation

CAD $380,000 - $420,000 OTE 50/50

Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it.

Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.

You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work.

Key Responsibilities

AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)

  • Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality.
  • Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources.
  • Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features.
  • Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.
  • Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments.

DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).
  • Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.
  • Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.
  • Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.
  • Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).
  • 3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.
  • Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).
  • Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.
  • DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).
  • Strong problem-solving & communication with a root-cause troubleshooting mindset, self-directed learning, strong ownership, and seamless remote/distributed team collaboration.

Company: Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc.
Position Type: Per Diem
Work Arrangement: Field-Based â Patient Home Visits
Compensation: $110â$130 per visit

Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc. is committed to providing professional nursing and healthcare services that help patients achieve the highest possible level of independence in their daily activities. We strive to deliver high-quality home health care through comprehensive patient assessments, individualized care planning, and collaboration among healthcare professionals, patients, and families.

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes and communities. The RN will assess patient and family needs, develop and implement individualized care plans, administer prescribed medications and treatments, educate patients and caregivers, and coordinate care with physicians and other healthcare professionals.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong clinical judgment, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. This role also involves discharge planning, case management when assigned, and supervising and evaluating home health aide services to support safe, coordinated, and effective patient care.

If you are passionate about helping patients maintain their independence and well-being at home, we encourage you to join our team.

Note: This is a field-based, per diem position that requires travel to patientsâ homes. Although listed as âremote,â this is not a work-from-home or telehealth role.

Responsibilities
    • Conduct initial patient and family assessments to determine home health care needs, including physical assessments and histories of current and previous illnesses.
    • Regularly reassess patientsâ nursing needs and evaluate changes in their conditions.
    • Initiate and revise individualized plans of care as patient status and needs change.
    • Use assessment findings to establish nursing diagnoses and develop appropriate care plans.
    • Develop care plans that establish patient-centered goals and incorporate therapeutic, preventive, and rehabilitative nursing interventions.
    • Involve patients and their families in care planning and decision-making.
    • Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by the physician.
    • Implement appropriate preventive and rehabilitative nursing procedures.
    • Counsel patients and families regarding nursing and related healthcare needs.
    • Provide patient and caregiver education based on assessments and the established plan of care.
    • Identify discharge planning needs during care planning and implement appropriate arrangements before patient discharge.
    • Serve as case manager when assigned by the Clinical Supervisor or Nursing Supervisor, coordinating care for the assigned patient caseload.
    • Prepare accurate clinical notes and update the primary physician as needed and at least every 60 days.
    • Communicate patient needs and changes in condition to physicians, and obtain or receive physician orders as required.
    • Coordinate with community healthcare professionals and other relevant parties to support the patient's plan of care.
    • Participate in on-call duties according to organizational policy.
    • Ensure arrangements for necessary equipment, supplies, and other patient services.
    • Instruct, supervise, and evaluate home health aide services provided to patients every two weeks.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned to support patient care.
    • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
    • Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) license in California.
    • At least 1â2 years of recent acute care experience in an institutional setting.
    • Current CPR certification.
    • Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle insured in accordance with state and organizational requirements.
    • Excellent observation and clinical assessment skills.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Effective problem-solving skills and basic mathematical skills.
    • Ability to perform nursing duties according to established competency requirements.
    • Ability to work independently and coordinate patient care responsibilities.
    • Ability to perform the physical duties associated with patient care, including prolonged standing or walking, lifting supplies and equipment, and assisting with patient positioning or transfers, with applicable accommodations.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in nursing.
    • At least 1 year of home health care experience.

Additional role responsibility: The RN is responsible for supervising home health aides. Previous management experience is not required.

At Serve Robotics, weâre reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. Itâs designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. Weâre looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Accountant supports the company's accounting operations by maintaining accurate financial records, performing assigned close activities, and preparing financial reports. The role executes and monitors key accounting processes, partners with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve discrepancies, supports audits, and helps maintain compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and company policies.

JOB DUTIES

  • Oversee the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and reports, ensuring completeness and accuracy.

  • Perform account reconciliations, including bank, accounts payable, and accounts receivable reconciliations, and resolve identified discrepancies.

  • Prepare and post journal entries and maintain an accurate and current general ledger.

  • Review, classify, and record expenses in accordance with company policies and applicable budget guidelines.

  • Oversee key accounting processes, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, inventory, accruals, and prepaid expenses.

  • Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and providing timely, accurate responses to requests.

  • Monitor accounting activities for compliance with GAAP, SOX requirements, internal controls, and established company procedures.

  • Identify and recommend process improvements that strengthen controls and increase the efficiency and accuracy of accounting operations.

EXPERIENCE, QUALIFICATIONS, & SKILLS

Required Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical accounting experience.

  • 5+ years of full accounting experience

  • Proficiency with accounting software such as Xero or NetSuite and intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, or GAAP, and a strong understanding of Sarbanes Oxley compliance processes, internal controls, and financial reporting requirements.

  • Strong organizational, time management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and partner effectively across teams.

  • High degree of accuracy and analytical ability, including the ability to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve accounting discrepancies and process inefficiencies.

Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Progress toward CPA certification.

  • Experience with a publicly traded company or public accounting firm.

  • Experience in a startup or other fast paced environment.

  • Experience with robotics, manufacturing, or technology companies, including exposure to inventory management or cost accounting processes.

  • Demonstrated ability to adapt and operate effectively in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time.

This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives.
  • Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning.
  • Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options.
  • Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates.
  • Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value.
  • Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences.
  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed.
  • Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift.
  • Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments.
  • Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar).
  • Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting.
  • Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves.

Nice to Have

  • Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile.
  • Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization.
  • Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery.
  • Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management.
  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements.
  • Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners.
